source_or_gap: User-confirmed October 29 Platonic-representation JEPA paper plus foundational JEPA, original PRH and H-Net coverage gap; existing V-JEPA 2 coverage retained.
chapter_action_policy: Use World Models for prediction/grounding limits, Substrates for objective/granularity/kernel distinctions and H-Net, and Learning Theory for theorem assumptions and metric/sample accounting.
merge_or_split_policy: No new chapter or structural merge; JEPA and H-Net do not introduce an unowned governance responsibility.
boundary_decision_rationale: Training objective, sequence hierarchy and cross-modal alignment are orthogonal axes of existing model, prediction and assumption owners. External PRH must not be conflated with Sorenson's Platonic World Model source.
external_literature_need: Extend selected passage review only for a stronger source-derived assertion; retain the documented version and scope.
proof_or_test_backlog: No new model run is needed to complete the editorial integration. Any future local performance claim requires exact tasks, baselines, data lineage, cost and independent evaluation.
evidence_transition_precondition: A separate accepted claim-specific transition is required for local/architecture support; source-reported alignment and conditional external theorems are not that transition.
required_before_drafting: Selected primary text reviewed and version-bounded notes written (completed 2026-11-02).
Existing-owner, deduplication and claim-ceiling decision recorded before prose (completed 2026-11-02).
promotion_blockers: New theorem assumptions are not satisfied by all practical JEPA models.
No demonstrated JEPA/H-Net combined model or whole-stack consequence.
residuals: Passage review is selected, not a full paper/code/proof audit.
H-Net v2 is the reviewed architecture source; later implementations and conference revisions are not silently substituted.
next_action: Maintain the selected-source notes and existing owner sections; extend passage scope or run model comparisons only for a separately specified scientific claim. No empirical campaign is a prerequisite for the completed editorial intake.
non_claims: No publication, model download/training, benchmark, evidence-state promotion, or validation of Sorenson's semantic constitution.
